projection: local tangent-plane equirectangular (x = R*radians(lon-lon0)*cos(radians(lat0)), y = R*radians(lat-lat0))
projection_reason: All layers use the scripted local-metres projection, matching the London scene's conventions. UTM 43N was not used for any layer because UTM grid north is ~0.36 deg off true north at this location, which would misalign UTM-projected layers against scripted ones by ~3 m at tile edges. The UTM 43N easting/northing of the origin is recorded below for reference only; no geometry was built from it.
import_path: scripted (section 4 fallback projection) for buildings, roads, green spaces, trees. BlenderGIS not installed or used.

extended_highway_widths.note: Highway types absent from the spec's width table, mapped to their nearest spec class at the user's request.

note_railway: railway way geometry was not rendered: the spec gives explicit widths for road/footway classes only, and inventing a rail-track width was avoided. Railway way count is recorded for honesty; public_transport point features (stops/platforms) are rendered as markers in /World/Transit.

simulation.note: User-approved extension beyond the original spec (which said no simulation files). Agents come from the unmodified Argus simulator; cars are illustrative.
simulation.citizen_calibration: Argus phase10 survey, 41 participants - not Pune residents
simulation.home_destination: phase10/assign_homes.py trip heuristic, not survey data
simulation.heuristic_inputs: drainage 0.5, flood_exposure 0.3, capacity/cooling by type, base_crowding by road class
simulation.agent_models: low-poly people and vehicles, illustrative geometry (not data)
simulation.before_after: demoState variant on /World: Stressed = before arm, Intervention = simulator after arm

view_400m.note: Display subset only; the simulator runs on the full 1 km tile.
view_400m.clipping: flat layers clipped at the edge; buildings/trees/transit kept only if fully inside; walkers/vehicles hidden per frame unless fully inside (view_run.usdc)
cameras: ProblemZone (aimed at the run's top problem zone)
view_400m.appearance_not_data: Facade windows (facade_tile.png), per-building plaster tints and roof colours are illustrative appearance, not OSM data. Heights and footprints are unchanged.
